findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Plug in your local AI. Give your folder superpow" → 3 lines (9 words, 46px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 11 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "100% open source · AGPL-3.0 →" (pill) above "Your cap table, in a folder you own."; "Why we built this" above "We lost our cap table paperwork."; "What it does" above "Everything Pulley did that you actually "; "Compare" above "Rent your cap table, or own it."; "Signatures" above "The only thing in the cloud is the unsig"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: IBM Plex Mono — e.g. "2", "100% open source · AGPL-3.0 →", "Reading 5 files…", "5 sorted · 1 needs you"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: 11 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Built on open source", "Why we built this", "What it does", "Compare").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ✦ ✓ ★ 👍
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div.scan → linear-gradient(rgba(79, 191, 133, 0) 0%, rgba(79, 191, 133, 0.18) 50%, rgba(79, 191, 133, 0) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 9 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: a.btn.btn-p → rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) 0px 1px 0px 0px inset, rgba(31, 111, 74, 0.6) 0px 8px  | button#getdl.btn.btn-p → rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) 0px 1px 0px 0px inset, rgba(31, 111, 74, 0.6) 0px 8px  | div.demo → rgba(31, 111, 74, 0.35) 0px 50px 100px -50px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 14 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div 1110px | div.drow.r1 1110px | div.drow.r2 1110px | div.drow.r3 1110px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 24 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 5 rows of identical boxed cards.
findings.fix: Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: Yellow-cream background (page background #fafaf8, section #fafaf8).
findings.fix: Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 15px.
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Longest paragraph runs about 101 characters per line.
findings.fix: Cap paragraphs at 45–75 characters (max-width: 60ch).

findings.message: 8 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: 2 sections carry text but no heading: section.wrap.fade-in at 734px (32 words); section#privacy.wrap at 10864px (237 words)
findings.fix: Give each section a short heading that names what it holds (the menu, the rooms, how it works, the price), in the heading face at the section size.

findings.message: 1 row(s) scroll sideways with content past their edge.
findings.fix: Jurors and most visitors read a row cut at the edge as clipped, not as scrollable. Wrap it onto more lines, or end it inside the grid.

findings.message: A 608px stretch at 2116px holds nothing.
findings.fix: Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: 4 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "The only thing in the cloud is the unsigned docu" → 3 lines (10 words, 32px); "Plug in your local AI. Give your folder superpow" → 3 lines (9 words, 32px); "Every line is public. Fork it, audit it, run it " → 3 lines (11 words, 32px); "Free forever. Your cap table never sits behind a" → 3 lines (10 words, 32px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "The only thing in the cloud is the unsigned docu" (screen 7, 21% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 3 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "Reading 5 files…", "SAFE_YC_signed.pdf", "scan_0042.pdf"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
